fields.statement: At c0a0879 (builder commit 78720ab), ran go test ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/daemon-notify$' -count=1 -v. With a fake rex on PATH and REX_BLOCK set, the first rhiza daemon --once over four fixture runs (one blocked on a question, one waiting at sign-off, one finished failed, one the daemon gave up on after a dead resumed process) wrote exactly four OSC 7501 state=blocked reports to stderr. Each was preceded by a working report, and their decoded msgs were 'CSQUESTION: a question waits on you: Which store?', 'CSSIGNOFF: a sign-off waits on you', 'CSFAILED: a run failed' and 'CSGAVEUP: the daemon gave up on a run'. A second --once with the same items wrote none. After the sign-off was approved and a new failed run was added, a third --once wrote exactly one ('CSFAILEDTWO: a run failed'). Read the diff: daemonNotify in internal/api/daemon.go runs on every poll, and the notified IDs persist in daemon.State.Notified, pruned to the items that still wait. Run notices are untouched. make fmt-check vet test passed with every package ok. In a clean clone at c0a0879, rhiza check printed ok. make self-check in the run checkout failed only on stale renders of actor records that the run added to the shared .git/rhiza log after the commit, including this verifier's own actor record.
